phases.objective: Make the universal conceptual rules normative for all new data work.
acceptance: All exported Drizzle schema modules are architecture-registered
All top-level data-lake layers are registered
Stable CI suite enforces registry coverage

phases.objective: Maintain a deterministic machine-readable inventory of database tables, migrations and repository data assets.
acceptance: Inventory is reproducible from repository state
Inventory drift fails CI
Schema-to-migration drift is a zero-tolerance forward invariant after convergence
Unsupported schema construction styles fail closed until the scanner supports them

phases.objective: Introduce a universal identity/addressability spine for canonical entities and events without replacing typed domain semantics or legacy local primary keys.
acceptance: UUIDv7 enforced for new canonical subject IDs
subject_kind explicitly distinguishes entity from event
Typed domain tables remain authoritative for entity/event semantics
Identity spine is not used as an EAV or generic fact store
Backfill is idempotent
No two legacy identities collide into one subject without an explicit resolution decision
Unresolved/not-applicable/no-canonical-target outcomes do not require a synthetic subject

phases.objective: Create one provenance model for every external source and acquisition run.
acceptance: Every recurring external ingestion has a source_id
Runs expose coverage/failure metrics
Existing source-specific provenance can be mapped without data loss

phases.objective: Register physical source artifacts by hash and storage locator while allowing bytes to remain outside PostgreSQL.
acceptance: All migrated artifacts have content hash and source ownership
Legacy publication attachments reconcile to registered artifacts
No public-safety scope is broadened

phases.objective: Separate source-stated, extracted, derived and editorial claims from resolved canonical values and explicit non-resolution outcomes.
acceptance: Derived canonical facts can be traced to evidence
Manual corrections supersede rather than erase automatic results
Unknown/ambiguous/not-applicable/insufficient-evidence states remain explicit
A source record is never forced into a canonical entity or event merely to complete the pipeline

phases.objective: Persist reusable versioned taxonomies and classifications in the canonical database.
acceptance: lamezia-canonical-taxonomy.v1 is DB-represented
Classifications record version/method/review state/evidence
Classification failure cannot silently drop a record
not_applicable, insufficient_evidence and review_required are first-class outcomes where applicable

phases.objective: Separate source record, publication, document, administrative act and administrative event while preserving the current public-safety boundary.
acceptance: Every current publication maps or has an explicit non-migration reason
Attachments and extracted text retain provenance
All acquired records receive a taxonomy outcome

phases.objective: Replace monolithic contract rows with procedure, lot, contract, lifecycle events, parties and financial events.
acceptance: Albo-only, ANAC-only, overlap and unresolved events reconcile
CIG is an identifier rather than an ingestion prerequisite
Legacy contracts becomes a compatibility projection before write freeze

phases.objective: Resolve Attuazione PNRR, Italia Domani, OpenCUP and related evidence onto canonical project entities.
acceptance: Same canonical project is not duplicated by source
CUP is modeled as an identifier
Source discrepancies remain visible as assertions

phases.objective: Introduce canonical persons and organizations shared across domains.
acceptance: Person identity is separated from mandate/role
Suppliers/attuatore/holders/assignees can reference organizations
Ambiguous name matching remains unresolved rather than forced

phases.objective: Model bodies, mandates, memberships, sessions, agenda items, attendance, interventions, votes, media and transcripts.
acceptance: Membership history remains temporally queryable
Votes can link to person/session/decision or agenda item where evidence permits
Transcript/media segments have stable provenance

phases.objective: Create shared place/location/geometry/assertion modelling and evaluate PostGIS.
acceptance: Source, resolved and public precision are distinct
New domain schemas stop duplicating geo field bundles
PostGIS decision is documented before spatial canonicalization

phases.objective: Convert confiscated assets from mutable status rows into asset identity plus lifecycle, party, cadastral and geographic relations.
acceptance: Seizure/confiscation/destination/assignment/reuse history is reconstructable
Legacy public view remains equivalent until cutover

phases.objective: Generalize the demographics series-release-observation pattern to all quantitative time-series data.
acceptance: Every migrated observation links to source release
Unknown/provisional/final statuses are explicit
Demographics remains losslessly compatible

phases.objective: Replace expanding polymorphic nullable-FK patterns with canonical cross-domain relations where appropriate.
acceptance: No new expanding nullable-FK polymorphism
Known internal targets use canonical subject relations rather than URLs
Typed domain-local FKs remain where they are the stronger model

phases.objective: Unify manual correction provenance without removing fast legacy override flags during transition.
acceptance: Previous automatic value remains auditable
Override actor/reason/time/supersession are recorded

phases.objective: Generalize the LTCEDS canonical-to-public projection boundary across public domains.
acceptance: Public APIs/static exports read public-safe projections
Internal sensitive fields cannot leak through ad-hoc runtime reconstruction
Projection policy/version is auditable

phases.objective: Keep the repository data lake as reproducible artifact/export storage while making canonical semantic ownership unambiguous.
acceptance: No material civic fact exists only in processed/curated/public without registered canonical/source ownership
Data-lake layer semantics match the architecture contract

phases.objective: Move semantic resolution out of Vite/Cloudflare build into validated canonical/public projection jobs.
acceptance: Vite serializes validated public data rather than resolving entities
Static fallback remains deterministic and checksum-verifiable

phases.objective: Publish versioned research snapshots with schema/taxonomy/source/coverage contracts.
acceptance: Snapshot declares schema/taxonomy/source cutoff
Coverage ledger and limitations are embedded
Artifacts are checksummed and reproducible

phases.objective: Freeze legacy writes and remove obsolete representations only after reconciliation proof.
acceptance: Legacy read equivalence demonstrated
No source evidence is deleted
Deprecation is documented per table/pipeline

phases.objective: Make architecture governance a permanent CI/review property.
acceptance: New tables/sources/data layers require registry ownership
Architecture inventory drift is reviewed deliberately
Domain migrations can update status without weakening universal invariants
Registry, migration plan and migration journal semantics are executable CI gates
